transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Since we're approaching the closing meeting with Northstar Diagnostics next Thursday, I want to make sure we're all aligned. We've completed technical diligence for the platform — the lab workflow software and implementation services — and the current draft grants Northstar distribution rights in North America with standard data-use, revenue-share, export, and conflicts provisions. Before I can approve this for signature, I need to hear from our responsible privacy, finance, export-controls, and conflicts lawyers: are there any issues that must be reflected in the agreement before we sign? Please walk me through where each of you stands.

Grace, on conflicts: since Northstar's parent is an existing client in an unrelated patent matter, we cannot proceed without Northstar's informed written consent to the conflict and an ethical screen isolating the patent-matter team from this deal. All four of these sets of issues must be incorporated into the draft before the closing meeting next Thursday. I am not approving the agreement for signature at this time. Please each take responsibility for getting your respective clauses circulated and incorporated into the draft promptly so we can finalize before Thursday.
